subject: terrapup
disposition: Flag-off multiview review candidate; installed model stays default. Not wired into data/creatures or any runtime path. The Creatures lane judges it.

generation.license: Existing owner-held Meshy license; Standing owner direction 1 (15 Oct 2026); no purchase

recovery.raw_inspection: One triangle mesh, one textured material (Image_0), no armature or clips; Meshy seam duplicates welded before skinning.

raw_render_inspection: Turntable of the raw source: brown puppy face with cream blaze, teal eyes, rounded ears, cream chest, grey stone back plates and stony tail, broad gold-clawed paws; head aligned with torso.

preparation.precedent: terrapup/candidate/source/prepare_native_candidate.py (measured joints, anatomical regions, local diffusion) and stormursa/source/prepare_native_candidate.py (weld/align/decimate keeping UVs); clips script copied unchanged from terrapup/candidate/source.
preparation.scale_rule: Uniform fit to the installed 3.85 m placeholder height; grows the raw source, never shrinks below the installed size; trainer reference 1.80 m.
preparation.pose_check: Blender pose_check renders (idle/walk/run/attack/hit/faint/fly_grip/swim) showed no tearing; not deformation approval.

gates.scale: height matches installed target; in-engine fit unproved
gates.skin_weights: Zero unweighted vertices; not deformation approval

limitations: Neutral procedural clips copied from the earlier candidate; no foot-lock, mount, swim, flight or combat proof
No native capture or code-blind judging yet
